name: Zoning (Géoportail de l’Urbanisme, France)
description: Reads the local plan zones (PLU / PLUi zones: U, AU, A, N…) around the point from the Géoportail de l'Urbanisme through the IGN Géoplateforme WFS (open data; France only). The zone code is read; what the zone allows is in the plan's regulations. It asks the service only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; nothing is sent at start-up, no key is used, and the answer is kept 24 hours in this browser.
author: YannFR81
